# Dormio Workspace Guidelines

## Capture Project Decisions

- During Dormio product or architecture discussions, record confirmed decisions in the most relevant existing Markdown file under `discussion/` before concluding the task. Update a suitable existing note rather than creating a duplicate.
- Treat `discussion/dormio-v1-scope.md` as the canonical list of confirmed V1 requirements, non-goals, and open product decisions. Treat `discussion/dormio-v1-architecture.md` as the high-level architecture note.
- Keep proposals, assumptions, and unresolved questions clearly labeled. Do not promote them to confirmed requirements without the user's agreement.
- After recording a confirmed product decision in its relevant discussion note, update the scope document when the decision changes V1 requirements, outcomes, non-goals, or open decisions.
- Keep documentation edits focused and preserve unrelated user changes.
